IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Select Committee on Hood Canal (originally sponsored by Representatives Appleton, Eickmeyer, Chase and Haigh)

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a survey of all geoducks and sea cucumbers in Hood Canal.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to geoduck harvest in Hood Canal; adding a newsection to chapter 79.96 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.96 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By December 1, 2007, the department shall conduct a comprehensivesurvey of all geoducks and sea cucumbers that exist in the Hood Canal.The survey must include all levels and depths of the Hood Canal. Themapping in the survey shall be done in grids, the size of which shallbe determined by the department.
Section 1 of this act expires July 1, 2008.
